policy: Irregularities and unverified items do not block publication. Each one is shown here with the source links needed to review it. Nothing in this list has been silently corrected or inferred.

items.title: Earlier builds mark rows verified without an official source
items.detail: An independent audit committed in this repo (session-e1e0c27e) found 26 of the 66 rows on the previous root hub marked verified:true while the only link was to ESPN, Wikipedia, BBC, Sky or an OLBG blog. This integration does not reuse those rows: the table you are reading contains only rows whose values were read on a governing-body domain.

items.title: Build A and Build B data were overwritten by a later session
items.detail: Commit cf9f024 (session 4359d6a4) rewrote data/rows.json from 144 to 137 rows, deleted four docs/sports pages and replaced Build B's per-claim sourced predictions with 25 templated texts, one of which compares Boston with the San Jose Sharks. The pre-overwrite files are recoverable at commit 5918922. Nothing was deleted by this integration, but the overwritten files are still wrong on main.

items.title: Ten fixtures carry opposite match-winner picks across builds
items.detail: The audit matched 93 fixtures that appear in two or more builds and found 10 with opposite winners (for example Hornets v Nets: Build C graded Charlotte High, Build A picked Brooklyn). Those picks are still published on the archive dashboards linked from this site, and they contradict each other.

items.title: Published clock times are not all in UTC
items.detail: NHL times are exact UTC from the league feed. NBA tip-offs are ET as published. The Premiership and WST pages render session times into the reader's own timezone and do not state it, so those times are printed exactly as they appeared and were not converted; treat them as approximate until you check the official page in your own timezone.

items.title: MLB publishes a local game date and a UTC start that differ
items.detail: World Series game 1 is dated 23 Oct locally but starts 2026-10-24T00:00:00Z. The table shows the local date (the one MLB prints) and the UTC instant separately so a reader in Asia or Europe is not misled.

items.title: Every snooker selection is withheld
items.detail: WST's match list publishes the pairing, match number and session time but no ranking, form or head-to-head. Our model therefore has no verified input that distinguishes the two players, so it publishes a 1.92/1.92 two-way price and no pick instead of inventing a favourite.

items.title: NBA opening week leaves 36 fixtures with almost no form
items.detail: Most clubs had played zero or one game at retrieval time, so the shrunk win percentage is barely different from 50% and no NBA row can be graded High. That is the honest output, not a modelling failure: the dashboards that show High-confidence NBA picks are using inputs that were not verified.

items.title: Match totals are declared constants
items.detail: No team scoring, pace or run-prevention figure was verified for these fixtures. Rather than infer one, every total is a declared constant (NHL 6.0 goals, NBA 226.5 points, MLB 8.5 runs, Premiership 44.5 points, EHF 57.5 goals) with both sides priced at 1.92, which claims no edge. Snooker totals are withheld.

items.title: Three NBA games in the window are missing from the table
items.detail: nba.com/games?date=2026-10-22 returned 'Sorry, something went wrong' on two attempts (2 games), and the 23 Oct page truncated after 10 of its 12 games. Those games are not guessed at; they are listed as a gap in the coverage table.

items.title: Thirteen in-scope sports have no published rows this cycle
items.detail: Tennis, darts, cricket, rugby league, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, esports, golf, motor racing, greyhounds, Aussie rules and Gaelic football. For tennis, darts and cricket an official page was opened and failed (see coverage table); for the rest no official page was opened at all. No row was copied from another build or from OLBG to fill the gap.

items.title: Gaelic football is treated as in scope
items.detail: The brief excludes soccer/football, boxing, UFC/MMA, American football, hurling, horse racing, cycling and specials. Hurling is named separately from football, so 'football' is read as soccer and Gaelic football is in scope. It has no verified row this cycle.

items.title: OLBG.com is unreachable from the build sandbox
items.detail: Every outbound request from the sandbox fails with SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL and only GitHub/PyPI/npm are allowed, so OLBG.COM itself could not be re-read in this session. OLBG is therefore used only as the taxonomy reference the brief supplies; no OLBG price, tip or figure appears in the published table.

items.title: EHF publishes a session time with no timezone
items.detail: The Champions League match list prints 18:45 and 20:45 without naming a zone. The times are printed verbatim and flagged; they were not shifted to CET or UTC.

items.title: Earlier builds publish fixtures that contradict the governing body
items.detail: The audit re-opened 18 rows against official pages and found 4 contradicted: a 'seven-game' ALCS that was six, a Pacific Championships fixture that does not exist in 2026 (the RLWC is being played), a Bruins record of 1-3 where NHL.com showed 7-2-0, and an Elite League pairing with records inverted. Those pages are still live in the archive; this site does not repeat them.
